development.summary: First release candidate in development. Everything below is in the repository and covered by 1,061 automated tests; no Windows executable has been published yet.
added: Weapon-slot crosshairs: record a key per slot and switch reticles mid-game without touching the game process.
Crosshair editor with per-arm length and thickness, whole-reticle rotation and scale, inner outline, colour tools with contrast verdicts, undo history and an A/B compare panel.
Preset manager with folders, favourites, descriptions, search and sort; built-in presets can be organised without being modified.
Versioned import and export with a two-step preview: nothing is overwritten unless that entry is set to replace it.
Game profiles with optional foreground-process auto-selection.
ADS morphing (shrink, dot-only, fade) and dynamic firing bloom with a configurable decay.
A live overlay window with F10 to toggle and F9 to cycle presets.
improved: Renderer bundle reduced by 35% by dropping legacy .woff font fallbacks Chromium never reads.
Storage migration runs once per install instead of on every launch.
Packaging configuration for an NSIS installer and a portable executable, with a release workflow that prints measured sizes and SHA-256 hashes.
fixed: Favourites were stored in two places that disagreed with each other.
An import could silently lose a crosshair when two entries wanted the same id.
The storage migration never wrote its completion marker on a fresh install, repeating its probe on every launch.
